description: To celebrate the Rotary Vocational Month, RCBN held this unique symposium covering the Golden Generation with a Rotarian each representing 70 / 80 & 90 years old Members of the Club presenting “0ne” episode of their life that has made a purposeful impact either professionally, economically, socially or even emotionally. The objective being to signify how “Generational Passion leaves behind a Legacy”. The speakers were Dr. PP Quresh Maskati (70 yrs ) , AKS CC PP Dr. Habil Khorakiwala (80 years) & Dr. Satya Agarwala (90 years) each intimately with care introduced by their wives. Being “World Polio Day” a brief overview “from where to where” was elucidated. The morning ended with the release of a brilliant 1st Edition of “RCBN’s Vocational Voice” the official news letter of Vocational Service. Club inducted Mr Roy Dias as a Member of the Club. Attended by 65 Members, 23 Partners taking total attendance to 88.
